description:
Qualifications* : JOB REQUIREMENTS (Education, Experience, and Training): 
 • Experience in Oracle 11g must. 

 • Experience in SOA Architecture is a huge Plus
 • Understanding of Web logic and Portal Framework is a plus
 • Knowledge of Oracle PL/SQL packages, procedure, design fundamentals, data modeling concepts
 • Experience with SQL tuning of application queries developed for large databases 
 • Strong analysis skills and experience working with users to gather requirements and suggest solutions is required.
 • Experience with export/import and loading data from files is required
 • Extensive knowledge of business requirements gathering, architecting, designing and developing complex Oracle based web applications and re-engineering products. 
 • Knowledge of process stabilization, performance analysis, code optimization and testing of web application and data-engineering products.
 • Knowledge of health care claims and health insurance industry preferred.
 • Experience working with business/IT users to understand business requirements, analyze existing code, and write functional and technical specifications.
 • Good organizational and follow-up skills and the ability to meet time sensitive deadlines
 • Good written and oral communication skills

 • Minimum Bachelors degree, or 4 years of related experience 
 • 5 - 8 years hands on experience in Oracle PL/SQL , JAVA, SOA Architecture including the ability to design and optimize complex queries.   


 
 Good comm skills are a big priority 
 Duration: 6+ months 
 As an Equal Opportunity Employer, the Company will provide equal consideration to all employees and job candidates without regard to sex, age, race, marital status, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, service in the Armed Forces of the United States, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.
